Remove the gray band and give the card a flat #2a2140 background."},{"element_id":"s01","problem":"The bottom nav center icon is a cat face. The real one is a gray-purple spiral swirl logo about 28px wide. The chip icons (Male, Anime, AnyPOV emoji) are also smaller and blurrier than the real ones.","fix":"Replace the center nav glyph with a circular spiral swirl in #9a8fb0, 28px, centered at x=205. Make the chip emoji 10px and aligned with the text baseline."},{"element_id":"s16","problem":"The background is a flat navy gradient with a dotted pixel pattern. The real one is a deep-space nebula with soft stars, and this is the largest red area. The logo 'o' is a cat-eye ring instead of a swirl.","fix":"Use a background of radial-gradient(#1c2a6b 0%, #0b1240 60%, #060a25 100%) with a few soft white 1-2px star dots and no regular grid. Draw the logo 'o' as a spiral swirl with a cat-ear tip. Make the serif headline slightly lighter."},{"element_id":"s06","problem":"The avatar is a cat in a bucket instead of the real shiba inu in a teal bucket with a mop. The Upgrade banner has a blocky dot pattern and is too flat and purple compared with the real starfield.","fix":"Draw a shiba head with orange and white fur in a teal bucket with a mop, 64px at x=122, y=20. Give the banner a dark navy #0f1a4a background with a few tiny star dots and a subtle glow, rounded 8px, ending at x=409. The logo 'o' should be a swirl."},{"element_id":"s08.e08","problem":"The hero image leaves a pale strip at the right edge and is not filling the rect. The image ends around x=352 with a pink strip.","fix":"Draw assets/s08.e08.art.png at x=29, y=108.6, w=322.6, h=198.8 with 12px corner radius, and hide any background showing on the right."},{"element_id":"s08.e31","problem":"The 'Playing as' avatar does not match the real shiba-in-bucket picture.","fix":"Draw assets/s08.e31.art.png at x=30.1, y=555.9, w=57.1, h=49.4."},{"element_id":"s08","problem":"The text is slightly bolder and 1-2px off in the header, the chips and the 'Chat with' button label. The mock's heart emoji in the comments is red instead of dark red.","fix":"Set the title weight to 500. Move the Chat with label down 1px. Use font-weight 400 for the definition text. Make the heart emoji #8b2a2a."}],"summary":"All tagged elements are within 4px and all taps work, so the remaining loss is visual. The largest areas are the s16 nebula background and logo, the s01 card art placement and nav icon, and the s06 avatar and banner. This round should place the listed pictures at exact rects and fix the backgrounds and icons."}
